info.description: UltraSpeed mode of MiMo-V2.5-Pro (FP4 MoE experts with DFlash speculative decoding on TileRT), exceeding 1,000 tokens/s. Offered as an application-only API trial from 2026-06-09 to 2026-06-23 at a limited-time price of 3x MiMo-V2.5-Pro.

zh.description: MiMo-V2.5-Pro 的 UltraSpeed 模式（MoE 专家 FP4 量化 + DFlash 推测解码，基于 TileRT），生成速度超过 1000 tokens/s。仅在 2026-06-09 至 2026-06-23 以申请制开放 API 体验，限时体验价为 MiMo-V2.5-Pro 的 3 倍。
